conflicts.fact: Lessons 1 and 2 present the photo as 'made twice as wide' or 'doubling the width and the height', while the fact sheet's distorted photo is made by doubling only the width.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 overview says 'the price more than doubled when the photo was made twice as wide', and the Lesson 1 Predict phase says 'the postcard P is made twice as wide'. Lesson 11 says 'when Mr Otieno doubled the width from print S to print P'. Lesson 2 says P was made 'by doubling the width and the height'. The fact sheet says doubling only the width gives the distorted 6 x 4 photo, so these statements about P contradict the other lessons.

conflicts.fact: Which lessons taught construction by rays from the centre, and how the lessons cite them.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 8 says it recalls the LSF of 2 'from Lessons 4-6'. Lesson 10 cites 'Lesson 8-9' constructions. The lesson map gives rays to Lesson 8, with fractional and negative k in Lesson 9, so citing both is acceptable. Lesson 8 predicts an image placed at the centre.

conflicts.fact: Cost of the distorted photo and the half-size print H.
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 gives the distorted photo area 24 cm2 and a price of KES 60 (24 x 2.5 = 60, correct). Lesson 11 reminds learners that H fits the pattern. No conflict in the numbers.
